source: art-direction/references/inventory.json. Seed verbs are the comprehension graphics. A verb is never used against its direction. Fit below 4 proposes a new entry instead of forcing a seed verb.

entries.rationale: A bottleneck is light being forced through one point. The published rays do this on the home bottleneck. Do not use pinch for a limit the copy treats as the goal.

entries.direction: two things combining at a shared waist
entries.form: Two lobes meeting at a dark waist
entries.rationale: Overlap is two fields sharing a dark waist. Meet is not a division of roles.
A method moves forward by stages. Rise is not a loop.

entries.direction: paths between parts that already exist
entries.rationale: Route joins parts that are already there. It does not turn one source into new outputs.

entries.form: One beam dividing into separate outputs
entries.rationale: Split is refraction: one source comes out as several outputs. It is not a path drawn between parts that already exist.

entries.concept: a chosen limit that keeps a system manageable
entries.form: A limit held around the light, not rays forced through a problem point
entries.rationale: Manageable adoption is a limit the page wants. Pinch is a constraint as a problem, so it points the wrong way.

entries.direction: the closed before-state, as a problem
entries.form: Rigid, heavy blocks; no connections except through people
entries.rationale: None of the seed verbs show a closed before-state. Keep only if a contrast claim needs a form for the old model.

entries.direction: unordered input, before it is organized
entries.rationale: Split names the result. It does not name the unordered input. Keep only when the copy is about the input itself.

entries.form: Unspecified. Must differ from the human mark in grayscale at 24px, come from the logo prism, sit on the 8px grid, and connect to a route.
entries.rationale: The verbs name relations, not the two kinds of actor. Keep only when the copy needs a human and an agent as distinct marks.

entries.form: Unspecified. Must read as a person without a literal figure or icon, differ from the agent mark in grayscale at 24px, sit on the 8px grid, and connect to a route.
entries.rationale: The verbs name relations, not the two kinds of actor. Keep only when the copy needs a human and an agent as distinct marks.

entries.direction: a boundary drawn around a system
entries.rationale: A frame around a system is not pinch, meet, rise, route, or split. Keep only when the copy is about the boundary itself.

entries.form: A graph of relationships, never a table
entries.rationale: Route connects parts of a workflow. It does not draw a data model. Keep only when the copy is about the model.
